name: installer-params
title: The installer parameters, as declared and as accepted
description: The managed-install contract and the README both list the switches the bootstrap accepts - NoPath, NoFont, NoExtensions and more - and nothing has compared that list with the param block the script actually declares. A switch a document promises and the script does not accept is a user-visible lie; a switch the script accepts and no document names is one nobody will find
creator: aixi
